card.title: 6th ALPINI REGIMENT
card.flavorText: The 6th Alpini Regiment is a regiment of the Italian Army’s mountain infantry. The regiment was formed in 1882 and has participated in many conflicts since then, including WWI and WWII where it distinguished itself in combat. In 1940 regiment fought with the Tridentina Division in France and was after that sent to Albania where it participated in the Italian attack on Greece. In 1942 the Tridentina joined the Italian Army in Russia and fought on the Eastern Front alongside the Germans. The Tridentina Division along with two other Alpini divisions were deployed along the Don River where they covered the left flank of the German Sixth Army during the Battle of Stalingrad. After the encirclement of the Sixth Army, the Red Army turned to the Alpini divisions and after 12 days of heavy fighting the Alpini divisions were almost annihilated. However, remnants of the Tridentine Division managed to break the encirclement and 4250 survivors managed to reach German lines in January 1943. The 6th Alpini Regiment was dissolved in 1943 after the signing of the Italian armistice with the Allies.
